- **Live TV fixes and faster opening.** A failed channel no longer traps the remote, guides that run out early are fetched again instead of showing "No guide", and the chosen category is kept after Live TV sits idle. M3U links and Xtream panels keep a saved copy of their channel list, so Live TV opens without asking the provider again within the guide refresh interval.
- **Replays keep going, and Start over.** A replay no longer stops at the guide's end time; it plays on into the next programme, or back to live once caught up. Hold OK on a live channel to start the current programme from the beginning where the provider keeps it.
- **Cleaner guide.** Six channels with a bigger header, no black gap after long programmes, short programmes grow to show their title when selected, and letting go of ▲▼ lands without a wobble. ▲ on the first channel no longer jumps to categories.
- **Programme list in the player.** In the player's channel list, ▶ on a channel shows its programmes top to bottom (the full guide no longer opens in the player).
- **Sources and lists.** The order of your sources syncs between devices, with Move up/down in Sources. New playlist is gone from the categories list and from the playlist chooser, and the chooser shows "Remove from" for lists a channel is already in.
- **AutoSync on PGS-only files.** An embedded subtitle index that takes longer than 7 seconds to parse is kept (up to 20 seconds) instead of being thrown away.
- **Smoother seek previews.** Scrubbing pauses the video, preview frames keep up while you hold a scrub, and the video is copied only while a frame is still due.
